_comment: Tracker's warm palette -> Flo Kit 2.0 neutrals. App variant only; build.py applies it to inline style= attributes when writing site/app/tracker/index.html.
_provisional: Resolved against the Flo Kit colour ramps: foreground/neutral default #161617, muted #5C606B, faint #8E95A5; surface/canvas #FAFBFC; outline/neutral default #C8D0DF, faint #DEE4ED.
_scope: Derived from every hex in the template, not just inline style= attributes -- chart gridlines, scrollbars and hover states live only in <style> blocks and JS.
_protected: chart series colours, plus anything with chroma > 60 (errors, warnings, status tints)
_tint: Tracker tinted surfaces (caption rows, header rows, row hovers, scrollbar tracks) map to Flo Kit white-10 #F8FAFC, not pure white -- keeping the shade of separation from the card surface that the warm theme had.
_contrast: Stat numerals and active-tab colour use primary/50 #0174BE, not the darkest step. The tab track and card header band sit on primary/10 #EDF5FC so they separate from the white surfaces they contain. Uppercase table headers and eyebrow labels take neutral/80 #393B41 rather than foreground/muted #5C606B -- muted lost 1.35 of contrast against the tracker's warm grey, and small letterspaced caps need it back.
